tools.name: check_website
tools.description: Checks a public website with Sitecomb. It returns a website quality review: the areas that have problems, with a count for each, and an overall score out of 100. It does not name the problems: those are in the full quality report. Use it when someone asks whether their website is any good, or what i

tools.name: explain_area
tools.description: Explains what Sitecomb looks at in one of its six areas, by id: security, privacy, quality (page health), phones, customers or ai. Use it when someone asks what Sitecomb checks, or about an area named in a check_website result. It doesn't check any website.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_website" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
